summary.headline: The eval-19 one-word-per-line stacking is gone: 19 of 20 runs lay captions out on 1-2 lines with generous side margins, and the reports' wrapped/split/size_used numbers agree with the pictures. What remains is narrower — the unbreakable word "Supercalifragilísticoespialidoso" still bleeds past both frame edges in all three cs2 runs (each honestly reported), rep3/cs1 regressed to 3-4 line stacks after the agent raised max_lines to 4 without saying so, and rep1/cs3 rewrote the user's caption text while quoting a "text_unchanged": true field.
